changelog: Claude Desktop gateway stability fix: coordinates Claude Code native /compact with Kiro-Go request-size guarding; preserves active tool_use/tool_result context during truncation; infers the live Claude cwd from transcripts for auto compact so stale ProjectDir config does not steer new sessions into the wrong project; avoids injecting compact ProjectDir as the live prompt project root; classifies 400/413 as non-retryable; and treats endpoint/model-specific 429 quota responses as endpoint cooldowns unless account usage is truly at the account limit.
